This entity is Uranus as depicted in a United States Postal Service planets stamp issue. Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun, an ice giant known for its pale blue-green color and its axis tilted nearly on its side. The VeVe collectible is a licensed digital rendering of the USPS planet stamp artwork.
